name: core.openwop.workflows.approvals
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013) — the Approvals cluster, the single most-used enterprise automation shape (Power Automate's #1 template is a sign-off flow with ~3.35M instantiations): Request Sign-off (an open gate any team member can approve — the zero-config marquee) and Two-Stage Sign-off (an ordered approval chain: stage two is only asked after stage one approves — sequential chains are DAG composition, not a new primitive). Gates support quorum (requiredApprovals), named approvers (approverRefs), and out-of-office delegation (an approver's active delegation lets their delegate act, counted as ONE identity). All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: openwop
